# [In preview] Public Preview: Use the Messages API with model router in Microsoft Foundry

## What Changed

Model router in Microsoft Foundry supports the Messages API in public preview. Messages-based applications and coding tools can use automatic model selection while keeping the Anthropic request and response format.Messages requests route only to supported

## Why It Matters to a CSA

A preview can inform roadmap and technical validation, but is not a production commitment.
